notes: WebRTC mandates encryption: DataChannels run over DTLS, so traffic is encrypted between peers by default (MDN).
Common browser pattern: slice File into chunks, send over a reliable/ordered DataChannel, reassemble on the receiver (WebRTC sample).
DataChannel max message size differs by browser/SCTP (roughly 16KB safe, 64KB max); chunking plus bufferedAmount backpressure is required.
Signaling is outside the WebRTC spec; a manual copy/paste SDP exchange can connect two peers with no signaling server (dev.to demo).
Serverless P2P transfer removes upload/size limits, but SDP/ICE still must be exchanged out-of-band (link, QR, copy/paste).
